title: Verse 1
text:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः।

मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय।।1.1।।
transliteration:
dhṛitarāśhtra uvācha
dharma-kṣhetre kuru-kṣhetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāśhchaiva kimakurvata sañjaya
word_meanings: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do when they gathered on the holy field of Kurukshetra, eager for battle?

commentaries.text: The commentary text for Aadi Shankaracharya for Verse 1, Chapter 1.
